name: IBY_TRXN_FI
description: IBY_TRXN_FI contains the details of a payment request that are specific for systems that support both bank account transfers and credit cards such as Financial Institutions.

columns.name: SPLITID
columns.description: counter that indicates the sequence in the split shipment

columns.name: PSREQID
columns.description: system generated ID that will be sent to FI Back End Payment Systems  during schedule of payments with them

columns.name: REFERENCECODE
columns.description: referencecode from Back End Payment System

columns.name: AUXMSG
columns.description: any auxillary message that may be returned by the payment system or processing system

columns.name: SRVID
columns.description: ID returned by Back End Payment System  when the payment is scheduled

columns.name: PROCESSFEE
columns.description: The fee charged for processing a transaction

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
